clue.text: One who drives it presumably will not offer a soft option

definitions.text: One who drives it presumably will not offer a soft option

parts.words: One who drives it presumably will not offer a soft option
parts.note: the idiom of driving a tough deal is read literally: whoever drives such a deal makes no easy concessions

explanation.surface: A tough negotiator never gives an easy way out.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who insists on strict terms in a negotiation is said to drive a tough deal, the opposite of a soft one.

clue.text: Old hymn tune-following many others?

definitions.meaning: The famous psalm tune sung to 'All people that on earth do dwell'
the item numbered after ninety-nine earlier ones comes behind a great many

explanation.surface: A traditional church melody that comes after plenty of others.
explanation.definitionFit: The ordinal for one hundred names both the tune's title and a position reached after ninety-nine predecessors.

clue.text: Put more clothes on? Correct

definitions.meaning: to dress again, read playfully as a re- word
to put right a wrong or set a balance straight

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether to add a layer or fix things.
explanation.definitionFit: To rectify a grievance is to make amends; split apart, the word also means clothing someone a second time.

clue.text: Said bow-legged bird had a rat

indicators.note: said tells us the word for bow-legged is only spoken, its sound kept but spelling changed

parts.note: bandy legs curve outward, so bow-legged means bandy
the coot is a black water bird

explanation.surface: Someone reports that a bandy-legged bird kept a pet rodent.
explanation.walkthrough: The bandicoot is an Australian marsupial, and in Asia the name is also given to a large rat, which is what the definition uses.
explanation.definitionFit: The bandicoot rat is a large South Asian rodent, so the name labels a kind of vermin.

clue.text: Dance that's weird to a degree

parts.note: rum is British slang for odd or strange
BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a university degree

explanation.surface: A dance described as thoroughly strange.
explanation.definitionFit: A Cuban ballroom style in four-four time, a kind of Latin step.

clue.text: One who is making a formal request is creating a ripple

definitions.text: One who is making a formal request

indicators.note: creating suggests the letters of the following words are worked into something new

explanation.surface: A petitioner stirs things up with a small disturbance.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who submits an application, as for a job or a grant, is an applicant.

clue.text: A fan I waved about in the canteen

indicators.note: a fan waved about is flapped around, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone flaps a fan around in a stuffy mess hall.
explanation.walkthrough: The NAAFI (Navy, Army and Air Force Institutes) runs shops and canteens for British service personnel.
explanation.definitionFit: The forces' institute name is used for its refreshment rooms on military bases.

clue.text: Made to pay for the wrongdoing

definitions.text: Made to pay for the wrongdoing

parts.words: Made to pay for the wrongdoing
parts.note: describes a penalty in money imposed by a court for an offence

explanation.surface: Someone was punished financially for misbehaving.
explanation.definitionFit: A monetary penalty imposed for an offence obliges the offender to hand over cash.

clue.text: Put your trust in this physician?

definitions.text: Put your trust in this physician?

parts.words: Put your trust in this physician?
parts.note: a healer who works through belief rather than medicine needs the patient's trust

explanation.surface: Advice to rely on a particular doctor.
explanation.definitionFit: A person claiming to cure illness through prayer or belief, rather than medical treatment.

clue.text: Handle a piece of armour found on the door

parts.note: handle is slang for a person's name
plate is a sheet of metal armour, as in breastplate

explanation.surface: A doorknob and some armour plating are discovered on a door.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Handle' looks like the door handle of the surface, but it is slang for a name.
explanation.definitionFit: A small sign bearing the occupant's title is fixed to an office or house entrance.

clue.text: We run until we drop in this race

definitions.text: We run until we drop in this race

parts.words: We run until we drop in this race
parts.note: in this sports-day event runners carry a balanced item and are out once it falls

explanation.surface: Competitors describe an exhausting race run to collapse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Until we drop' suggests exhaustion; it really means until the egg drops off the spoon.
explanation.definitionFit: A children's sports-day race in which runners carry an egg balanced on a spoon.

clue.text: This Middle Easterner is king retrospectively, I concluded!

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: looking back, so the king's name is read from right to left

parts.note: Lear is Shakespeare's king
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone from the Middle East declares himself a king, looking back.
explanation.definitionFit: A citizen of the Jewish state on the eastern Mediterranean is a person from that region.

clue.text: Permanent dwelling

explanation.surface: A permanent home.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both enduring for ever and residing, from abide meaning to stay or live.

clue.text: The man's, about now, in the underworld

indicators.note: about means the first letters surround the next piece

parts.note: the man's contracts to he's, meaning he is
AD, anno domini, is the present era, hence now

explanation.surface: A man is currently down in the nether regions.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth the realm of the dead lies beneath the earth.

clue.text: Hormone store gone awry

indicators.note: awry means gone wrong, so the letters are thrown out of order

explanation.surface: A hormone kept in storage has gone off.
explanation.definitionFit: The female sex hormone is one of the body's chemical messengers.

clue.text: It is not clear how the eggs were prepared

definitions.meaning: jumbled and unintelligible, as a coded message
beaten and cooked in a pan

explanation.surface: Confusion about the way breakfast was cooked.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means garbled, as a signal, and also describes eggs whisked and stirred while cooking.

clue.text: Al got Len's complaint, it is painful

indicators.note: painful suggests a twisting, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: One man caught another's illness and it really hurts.
explanation.definitionFit: A hard stone forming in the bladder for bile is a medical ailment.

clue.text: Shower?

parts.note: read as one who shows, not a spray of water, it means someone displaying work

explanation.surface: A single word about a wash.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who displays goods or works at a fair or gallery shows them to the public.

clue.text: Case space?

parts.note: a small room where suitcases and boxes are stored

explanation.surface: A question about room for luggage.
explanation.walkthrough: In British homes this is the small spare room used for storing boxes and luggage.
explanation.definitionFit: A small storage room in a house, where trunks and cartons are kept.

clue.text: Eventually cut off in the mountains

indicators.note: cut off means the final letter is lopped

parts.note: eventually means at last

explanation.surface: Someone ends up stranded in the hills.
explanation.definitionFit: The range across Morocco, Algeria and Tunisia in North Africa is a mountain chain.

clue.text: To rear, a new device for putting air in

indicators.note: new tells us the letters make a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A new gadget for a lawn is placed at the back.
explanation.definitionFit: A tool or machine that pumps or forces oxygen into soil or water.

clue.text: Axle set to go round using milky juices!

indicators.note: to go round suggests turning, so the letters are spun into a new order

explanation.surface: An axle fitted to turn on lubricating fluids.
explanation.definitionFit: Rubber trees and other plants exude a white sap.

clue.text: Subject to endless choice

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: endless means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a pick is a choice, as in take your pick

explanation.surface: Being exposed to unlimited options.
explanation.definitionFit: A theme or matter under discussion.

clue.text: More bashful one having a fling

definitions.meaning: someone who shies, that is throws

explanation.surface: A rather timid person enjoys a brief romance.
explanation.definitionFit: The comparative of timid, and an agent noun from the verb meaning to toss.

clue.text: After a short time, revised score for dance

parts.note: mo is short for moment, a short time

indicators.note: revised means changed, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: After a break, the music for a dance is rewritten.
explanation.walkthrough: 'After' sets the brief moment first in the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A Moorish dance, the morris's ancestor.

clue.text: Oral part I somehow adapted for seizing prey

indicators.note: somehow suggests the letters are put together in some other way

explanation.surface: A part of the mouth is evolved to grab food.
explanation.definitionFit: Describes birds of prey and their talons, built for grasping victims.

clue.text: Their leader goes right round on the course

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

parts.note: O is round in shape
taken as written

explanation.surface: A captain makes a tour of the golf links.
explanation.walkthrough: Royal Troon is a golf course on Scotland's west coast that hosts the Open Championship.
explanation.definitionFit: A Scottish seaside town famous for its championship golf links.

clue.text: A raider came round for good fellowship!

indicators.note: round suggests the letters are turned about into a new order

explanation.surface: A bandit dropped by to share some friendship.
explanation.definitionFit: Mutual trust and friendliness among people who spend time together.
